name: Bimbo High
source:
You play an 18-year old kid whose life was turned upside down when your dad remarried a month before the start of the game. All of a sudden, you’ve got a new family and if that wasn’t enough, your stepmom’s gotten you transferred to the school where she works.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/p1nups]Patreon[/url]]
